# Zeeshan Sarfraz Portfolio

> Zeeshan Sarfraz is a Full Stack Developer, Software Engineer, and Computer Science (BSCS) student at NUML Lahore. Specializing in React, Flutter, Node.js, and Firebase. Founder / Lead at Zyfiro.

## Projects

- [z-nectar](https://github.com/xeeshan-zs/z-nectar): All-in-one mobile application for student services and utilities.
- [EduSync](https://github.com/xeeshan-zs/EduSync): Smart education management platform for tracking assignments and schedules.
- [Library Management](https://github.com/xeeshan-zs/Library-Management): High-performance C++ OOP management system.
